ceiling_directive: Impose a primitive quantitative interior-slack condition on the same loading-mean model and prove matching same-shell risk and honest-width lower bounds using a legal target-separating deformation at scale min{1, (sqrt(N)s_N)^{-1}}.
improvement_directive: Strengthen the frozen class with a primitive nondegeneracy condition that excludes target collapse, then construct same-shell alternatives with target separation comparable to min{1, (sqrt(N)s_N)^{-1}} and bounded testing divergence. Use that pair to prove matching minimax-risk and honest-rectangle-width converses.
critique: The note proves certificate-based sufficient identification, generic factor-plane ambiguity after certificate failure, a strict O3 containment example, and one-sided risk and confidence-width upper bounds. It does not deliver the advertised identification iff: certificate failure is explicitly shown not to imply causal-target nonidentification under the stated class. Likewise, the results named a singular or minimax frontier have no positive risk converse, honest-width converse, or necessary consistency threshold; the proved rate statements are achievable upper guarantees only. Because the combinatorial certificate is published background and the new causal transport is a direct covariance-eigenspace reconstruction under spherical errors, the remaining contribution is useful but too narrow and incomplete for the field floor, while the absent lower-bound experiment materially limits the projected paper score. The score assesses the delivered research package without credit for unfinished work.]
